Autoliv Q3 2026 results order intake Chinese domestic OEM market share

findings.claim: Autoliv 全球被動安全份額由 1997 年 27% 升至 2025 年約 44%；安全帶約 45%、氣囊＋方向盤約 44%
findings.excerpt: This has enabled Autoliv to increase its global market share in passive safety from 27% in 1997 to around 44% in 2025.

findings.claim: 10-K 列出的其他競爭者為日本 Nihon Plast、Ashimori，中國 Yanfeng、Jinheng，韓國 Samsong，南美 Chris Cintos；合計佔其餘多數份額
findings.excerpt: Other competitors include Nihon Plast and Ashimori in Japan, Yanfeng and Jinheng in China, Samsong in South Korea, and Chris Cintos de Seguranca in South America.

findings.claim: 中國本土車廠佔 Autoliv 中國銷售由 2022 年 22% 升至 2025 年 44%；BYD 高度垂直整合，被動安全由子公司 FinDreams 供應，Autoliv 僅供應零件（主要為氣體產生器）
findings.excerpt: BYD has a uniquely high degree of vertical integration, with a large proportion of in-house sourcing of products and systems. This includes passive safety systems, which is supplied by its subsidiary FinDreams Technology. Autoliv supplies components, especially inflators, to FinDreams Technology.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：亞洲（中國、韓國、印度）競爭激烈，預期有更多國際與本土競爭者進入，可能導致降價、毛利下降與無法維持份額
findings.excerpt: We anticipate that additional competitors, both international and domestic, may seek to enter the Chinese, South Korean, and/or Indian markets resulting in increased competition.

competitive_share_entrants.note: Q3 2026 8-K（中國本土車廠佔中國銷售 58% vs 去年 46%；本土 OEM 銷售有機成長約 21%、全球 OEM 約 -29%）與 Moody's 2026-06 信用報告（歐洲份額 52%、美洲 47%、中國 33%；主要對手 ZF、Joyson）僅見搜尋摘要，列於 clues。

clues.claim: Q3 2026：Autoliv 對中國本土 OEM 銷售有機成長約 21%，對全球 OEM 下降約 29%；本土 OEM 佔中國銷售 58%（去年同期約 46%）
Moody's 2026-06：Autoliv 區域份額歐洲 52%、美洲 47%、中國 33%；主要競爭者為 ZF 與 Joyson Safety Systems
